static_traits.name: Zhang Tao
static_traits.social_status: Avoids socializing at Work, Relationship with colleagues affected; has one good friend but not yet discussed own troubles.
static_traits.medical_history: without similar problem history;without previous psychotherapy;without significant physical illness.
static_traits.language_features: Good cooperation, clear expression, acceptable logic; tone calm but rather tired, capable of self-Reflection; overall mood neutral leaning toward Repression.

basic_info.main_problem: I believe that sleeping a lot because Work is too tiring makes others see me as lazy, which gives me guilt and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: Guilt and Self-doubt have affected my mental health and Work performance, so I am seeking counseling.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on the views of others

special_situations.event: When interacting with colleagues or supervisors at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I appear tired in front of them or mention needing rest, I will be seen as lazy and not trying hard enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing communication with others, staying silent to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am lazy.

special_situations.event: After work hours increase significantly, needs long catch-up sleep after work or on weekends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I sleep a lot, it means I lack self-discipline and am not as good as others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcibly compressing sleep, skipping rest to prove I am not lazy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will label me as lazy, and work will get worse and worse.

special_situations.event: Decreased attention or declining performance noticed by others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly, it is my personal incompetence, causing trouble for others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pushing through overtime, harsher on oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault,I am not good enough, letting down everyone's expectations.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not push through without rest like they do, it means I am not as good as others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compares herself with others and criticizes herself, further compressing rest time
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am worse than them; I am too lazy.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and recognized, especially that one's legitimate need for rest and recovery can be accepted
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as lazy or weak, thus being negated, rejected, or affecting Work security
defense_goal: Avoids being judged by hiding needs and avoiding help-seeking
Maintaining a sense of recognition and security through overwork and self-Repression

object_relations.self_representation: A tired, guilty person who 'does not do well enough'
object_relations.object_representation: A harshly judging other who easily negates people (colleagues/supervisor)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about expressing the need for rest to colleagues or supervisors, or thinking of others' possible reactions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will accuse me of laziness like the imagined 'judge' inside (transference: projecting self-criticism onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone cautious and reserved, tending to use hypothetical sentences (like 'maybe, perhaps'), avoiding direct expression of personal needs, describing more of others' views.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When Decline in work performance or scattered attention is noticed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing all problems stem from oneself not being good enough, feeling guilty and self-blaming
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming language (like 'It is all my fault'), tone low, reducing discussion of objective Work conditions, focusing more on Self-denial.

manifestations: Not yet discussed own troubles with good friends
Avoids socializing at Work,Keeping distance from coworkers
Living alone, actual use of emotional support insufficient
outcomes: Anxiety worsened, worrying about being judged by others
Subjective sense of helplessness, declining sense of value

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Knowing I am tired but reducing sleep and skipping rest to 'tough out' work
Not expressing rest needs to colleagues, turning pressure inward into self-exhaustion

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Excessively worrying about others' evaluations, repeatedly blaming oneself 'I am not good enough/they will think I am lazy'
Overly cautious when interacting with others, avoiding expressing needs

positive_force: Has one close friend (a potential support resource)
Willing to try journaling and behavioral experiments, with some self-Reflection and motivation to change
High work engagement, strong sense of responsibility
negative_force: Cognitive biases like mind reading and predicting the future, excessive concern about others' evaluations
Obvious Self-doubt and guilt tendencies, prone to personalizing problems
Social avoidance, reducing access to real-world support
Compressing sleep to prove one is not lazy, leading to further decline in energy and performance

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and Anxiety in Work settings
antecedent: When interacting with colleagues or supervisors
When thinking others may judge them as lazy
target_behavior.core_reason: High-threat interpretation of others' evaluations, mind reading, predicting the future and other cognitive biases, fearing being labeled 'lazy'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships damaged, Decreased support, Anxiety maintained and affecting focus and performance

target_behavior.behavior: Forcibly cuts sleep, skips rest, and pushes through work
antecedent: When seeing others energetic or performing well
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing the belief 'should work harder to not count as lazy', using overwork to undo the Anxiety of being judged
target_behavior.function: Seeking external approval, avoiding being blamed and seen as weak
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening fatigue, Sleep disturbance, further decline in Work performance, forming a vicious cycle
